$comment: The list of Darkmatter ports. The website and the README table are built from it. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

ports.name: Ghostty
ports.description: Darkmatter adapted for Ghostty, a multi platform terminal built with Zig

ports.name: WezTerm
ports.description: A Darkmatter color scheme for WezTerm, as a colors TOML file or a Lua table.

ports.name: Alacritty
ports.description: Primary, normal, and bright color blocks in TOML for Alacritty 0.13 and up.

ports.name: st
ports.description: A colorname block for the suckless simple terminal. Paste it into config.h and rebuild.

ports.name: Neovim
ports.description: A full Noevim colorscheme with treesitter, LSP, and plugin highlights.

ports.name: Zed
ports.description: Darkmatter as a Zed theme extension, covering the editor, terminal, and UI.

ports.name: TextMate
ports.description: A .tmTheme for anything that speaks TextMate grammars, including bat and Sublime Text.

ports.name: Yazi
ports.description: A Yazi flavor with Darkmatter file colors, icons, and code previews.

ports.name: OpenCode
ports.description: Theme JSON for the OpenCode terminal agent.

ports.name: Amfora
ports.description: Page, link, and modal colors for the Amfora Gemini browser.

ports.name: Nushell
ports.description: Syntax and table colors for Nushell, matching the terminal palette exactly.

ports.name: GTK
ports.description: GTK 3 and 4 and xfwm4 window decorations, with wallpapers.

ports.name: Rofi
ports.description: A rasi theme for the Rofi launcher.

ports.name: Dunst
ports.description: Notification colors for Dunst, with frames and progress bars keyed to urgency.

ports.name: Polybar
ports.description: The Darkmatter palette as a Polybar colors.ini, ready to include in your bar.

ports.name: shadcn/ui
ports.description: A shadcn/ui theme for Tailwind CSS v4, built with tweakcn.

ports.name: Darkmatter
ports.description: The core palette in CSS, Sass, Less, Stylus, JSON, Xresources, base16, and GIMP swatches.
